text: How do you create a Polymorphic VI?
options: Open a VI’s Properties (File >> VI Properties), and select ‘This is a polymorphic VI.’ in the Execution category. In the tab that appears, select which VIs you would like to include.
Create two or more VIs with the same connector pattern, select File >> New >> polymorphic VI, select one or more of the VIs you created to include as an instance in the polymorphic VI
Drop a Polymorphic VI function from the Function Palette >> Application Control, right-click it and choose ‘Configure’, and select the VIs that you would like to include.
Highlight two SubVIs on a block diagram, in the toolbar select Edit >> Create Polymorphic VI.
